findings.evidence: The dbff837f digest says "removed units (42, showing 40)"; two removed units are not available for review.
findings.fix: Provide the complete digest so the remaining removed units can be checked against the current files and recovery record.

findings.evidence: The file-output case asserts "Includes non-empty output validation" but does not test that the requested page and substantive article content were recovered.
findings.fix: Add verifiable assertions for page identity, substantive content, and rejection of login or error output; add realistic contextual trigger queries alongside the short existing queries.

findings.evidence: For batches, the procedure says to "run one command per URL" and "Honor a supplied output path" without resolving a single file path supplied for multiple URLs.
findings.fix: When several URLs target one file, ask whether to use separate files in a directory or explicitly combine results; never repeatedly write the same path without confirmed overwrite behavior.

findings.evidence: The initial command only specifies --print or --out; the known selector is added in step 5 only after missing content. A user who explicitly asks to wait for main has no instruction to pass that selector on the initial run.
findings.fix: When the user supplies rendering controls such as a known --wait-for selector, apply them to the initial command, subject to the browser-safety rules; retain the bounded retry for failed extraction.
